body.content: Speculative contradiction: Treat the workspace not as mutable state but as a Merkle-DAG of pending side effects. 'Reclamation' becomes a merge of unmaterialized effects into the trunk. Evidence is never displaced because it is a content-addressed node, not a file path; reclamation only reassigns unmerged leaves. This eliminates the notion of 'silent displacement' structurally rather than protocol-wise.
body.why_keep_this: Pushes the design space from crash-recovery protocols to data-structure invariants; asks whether the problem assumes an outdated mutable-workspace model.
